home_screen_page_creation.notes: Verified Add page button in Home Edit Mode (page 13+ -> Add page).

home_screen_page_deletion.notes: Verified delete_page_layout button in Home Edit Mode on empty pages.

max_pages.notes: 13+ pages already active on device; supports 16+ pages required for full category suite.

default_home_page_selection.notes: Verified default_page_button in Home Edit Mode.

home_screen_grid_options.notes: Native One UI supports 4x6 and 5x6; Home Up unlocks 4..5 x 5..7.

home_up_enhanced_layout.notes: Home Up 18.0.00.38 installed & enabled; DIY Home, folder grid, icon scale, and backup available.

folder_creation_and_renaming.notes: 9 existing named folders observed in LauncherProvider dump.

folder_capacity.notes: Existing Fitness folder holds 17 apps and UPI folder holds 14 apps across folder pages.

single_app_folder_retention.notes: Standard One UI Home dissolves a folder when reduced to 1 item; standalone icons recommended for 1-app banks (ICICI Bank, Axis Bank) unless user prefers a second shortcut.

native_shortcut_duplication.notes: Verified empirically in existing LauncherProvider dump (PhonePe on 3 pages, Gmail & Calendar on 2 pages).

duplicate_shortcuts_across_pages_and_fol.notes: PhonePe appears both standalone on Page 6/13 and inside UPI folder on Page 8; YouTube inside Google folder and on Page 6.

widget_placement_and_resizing.notes: Verified CategoryHeaderWidgetProvider placed on Page 1 (id=46, 4x1), rendered transparently, and cleanly removed.

multiple_header_widget_instances.notes: Per-appWidgetId configuration and reconfigurable WidgetConfigActivity supported.

widget_pinning_api.notes: requestPinAppWidget triggers Samsung 'Add to Home screen?' confirmation dialog; places on first available slot (not arbitrary target page).

widget_picker_target_page.notes: Opening Widgets from Home Edit Mode on target page places directly onto that page.

empty_page_retention.notes: Observed Page 5 and Page 12 retained with 0 items on One UI Home 18.0.07.53; Wallpaper Spacer widget also available as fallback.

dock_customization.notes: Hotseat holds up to 5 slots (currently Camera, Phone, Google Messages, Samsung Messages, Apps button).

home_up_backup_restore.notes: Verified Immediate backup created at 11/25/2026 03:17:30 inside Home Up.

accessibility_hierarchy_quality.notes: Home screen & Home Edit Mode expose clean bounds/IDs; wsCellLayoutContainer content-desc can report stale page index, so PageIndicatorMarker selection in dumpsys is used as ground truth; uiautomator dump may stall on animated Widget Picker bottom sheet (use screencap/dumpsys there).
